column4: A heavy full jute sack dragged a short way across a wet concrete floor and heaved up over the steel lip of an old machine's hopper: coarse cloth scraping, a dull heavy slump into it. Close up, concrete cellar, no music, no voices.
The heavy steel lid of an old machine's hopper dropped shut: a deep metal clang ringing in a small concrete cellar. No music, no voices.
An old heavy industrial machine running in a concrete cellar: a deep electric hum, a slow heavy drum turning with a steady dull knock, metal grinding on metal, unchanging. No music, no voices.
A heavy damp sack dropped back onto a wet concrete floor: one dull soft thud. Close up, cellar, no music, no voices.
